headwords.text: To see a truss in your dream, your ill health and unfortunate business engagements are predicted.
headwords.note: 기존 rupture(탈장) 상징에 문맥 1개 추가 — 새 이름 「탈장대」가 「탈장」을 품어(§25 곁가지) 그 상징에 합쳤다

headwords.text:
To dream of trusts, foretells indifferent success in trade or law.

If you imagine you are a member of a trust, you will be successful in designs of a speculative nature.

To dream of seeing a tub full of water, denotes domestic contentment.
An empty tub proclaims unhappiness and waning of fortune.

A broken tub, foretells family disagreements and quarrels.

To dream that you tumble off of any thing, denotes that you are given to carelessness, and should strive to be prompt with your affairs.

To see others tumbliing,{sic} is a sign that you will profit by the negligence of others.
headwords.note: 기존 fall(추락) 상징에 문맥 2개 추가 — 이미 별칭 「굴러떨어」를 쥐고 있어 새 이름을 세우면 겹쳤다

headwords.text:
To dream of going through a tunnel is bad for those in business and in love.

To see a train coming towards you while in a tunnel, foretells ill health and change in occupation.

To pass through a tunnel in a car, denotes unsatisfactory business, and much unpleasant and expensive travel.

To see a tunnel caving in, portends failure and malignant enemies.

To look into one, denotes that you will soon be compelled to face a desperate issue.

To dream of a racing turf, signifies that you will have pleasure and wealth at your command, but your morals will be questioned by your most intimate friends.

To see a green turf, indicates that interesting affairs will hold your attention.
headwords.note: 새 상징 경마장(racetrack) — 첫 문장만. 둘째 문장(푸른 잔디를 봄)은 기존 grass(풀)의 「푸른 풀밭을 봄」과 같은 그림이라 §31로 건너뜀. 「잔디」는 이미 grass의 별칭이라(§25 곁가지) 경마·도박이라는 다른 그림에는 「경마장」으로 이름을 갈랐다
